content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event and don't want to watch the full video, which runs over an hour, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the highlight reel of the event below.

Apple releases a brief recap of the event

In addition to the iPhone Duo and Apple's first foldable iPhone, Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, along with the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, as well as the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The event ran just under 1 hour and 20 minutes, adopting Apple's signature style with executives taking turns speaking to camera, interspersed with marketing demos and product adverts.

If you don't have time to sit through it all, Apple has also put out a rather entertaining short recap, with a narrator zipping through to help you hit the key points of each announcement.

Apple has also uploaded full standalone segments for each product, which you can watch one by one below.
